gate1.name: float32 zero-dose hook logits equal plain logits

gate2.name: float32 norms reproduce Part 119c
gate2.relative_difference_unit: median of within-row position medians, then median across rows

gate3.name: 2 alpha push equals twice alpha push

predictions.prediction: In float32 on real rows, the median row ‖I‖ follows a square law at low dose: log2 of its ratio between adjacent doses is within 2 plus or minus 0.3 from 0.025 to 0.05 and from 0.05 to 0.1.
The second-order identity holds at low dose and has broken by 0.2: on real rows the median row q is at most 0.30 at 0.05 and at least 0.50 at 0.2.
A push interacts with itself more than with a second push: at 0.1 the median row c over real rows is at most 0.75, and its product-weighted 95% unit-bootstrap interval lies below 1.
At each of 0.05, 0.1 and 0.2, the real median c is within a factor of 1.25 of the control median c.
At 0.4 on real rows, the median self share is at least half the median pair share and at most twice it: a push at 0.8 is about as far from twice itself as a pair at 0.4 is from the sum of its parts.

At 0.4, over the 39 first units, u is higher for slot units than for concept units: the slot median is above the concept median, with a one-sided Mann-Whitney p below 0.05 on Part 92's Haiku kinds, and the same direction on the units both readers agree on.
Across the 39 units, the Spearman correlation of u(0.4) with Part 119's dominance is at most -0.3.

At 0.1, a real unit's self term is the size of a random direction's on the same path: taking for each first unit the median row ‖S_B‖ on its real rows over the same on its control rows, the median over units lies between 0.8 and 1.25.

headline: At low dose a push interacts with itself more than with a second push. This also covers the matched random second pushes under 120.4.
bootstrap_definition: Part 119c's unit bootstrap draws (2,000 draws, seed 12001); each draw uses product weights counts[first]*counts[second] as primary and sum weights counts[first]+counts[second] as sensitivity. The reported statistic is the weighted median row c.
position_rule: At each alpha with a 2 alpha pass, a position is eligible when norms of P, S_A, and S_B are all above zero. Row values are medians over eligible positions; class values are medians over rows. Dose 0.8 has no 1.6 pass, so only its raw interaction norm is reported.
gate2_rule: For each statistic and dose, compute relative error per matched position, take each row's median, then the median across selected rows; every cell must be complete and strictly below 0.5%.
